dist-crm-pricing-2026-08-30.body:
I analysed pricing across 35 CRM platforms.

The interesting part wasn't the cheapest platform.

It was what the medians and free-plan share actually look like when you refuse to invent market averages:

• USD CRM products with plans: 35 (n=35)
• Median starting price (USD/mo): $23 (n=29)
• Share offering a free plan: 28.6% (n=35)
• Median annual billing discount: 25% (n=15)
• Starting price $0 (free starting): 2 (n=29)
• Starting price $1–$14: 7 (n=29)

Method + sample notes: /research/crm-pricing/

(Work done via SoftwareGlimpse research — figures are catalogue-derived, not survey folklore.)
